answers.text: Tell it to log the drop-off in three lines every time: time, pallet count, then any damage - always in that order.
Ask it to turn the calls into a follow-up list.
Something about the finishing time on that note doesn't add up - six hours from 8am shouldn't run into the next day. Worth a look.
118 up from 96 does look like a fair jump this month.
I'd sign off Output 2, since it shows the actual ticket numbers behind the 88%.
I'd probably go with the second email.
